name: Abimelech
summary: The king of Gerar who was told by Abraham that Sarah was his sister, and later by Isaac that Rebekah was his. Each time he made a covenant of peace with them.

key_moments.title: Warned in a Dream
key_moments.description: After Abraham said Sarah was his sister, Abimelech took her, but God warned him in a dream. Abimelech gave Sarah back with gifts, and when Abraham prayed, God healed his household.

key_moments.title: Covenant at Beersheba
key_moments.description: Abimelech came to Abraham, saying God was with him in all he did. They settled a quarrel over a well and swore a covenant at Beersheba.

key_moments.title: Learns Rebekah Is Isaac's Wife
key_moments.description: Isaac told the men of Gerar that Rebekah was his sister. When Abimelech saw Isaac with her, he knew she was his wife, and he warned his people not to touch either of them.

key_moments.title: Peace with Isaac
key_moments.description: Abimelech came from Gerar with Phichol, his army's captain, saying they had seen that the LORD was with Isaac. Isaac made them a feast, and they swore peace with each other.
